panels.title: Metrics: latest value per metric and subject (edge_framework.md §6.2 triggers)

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (name, subject) name, subject, round(value::numeric, 3) AS value, status, detail, ts FROM ops.metric ORDER BY name, subject, ts DESC

WITH l AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (name, subject) status FROM ops.metric ORDER BY name, subject, ts DESC) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'alarm') AS alarm, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'warn') AS warn FROM l
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'fail') AS fail, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'warn') AS warn FROM ops.dq_result

panels.title: Hours since the last landed file

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(extract(epoch FROM now() - max(landed_at)) / 3600) AS hours FROM raw.source_file
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'queued') AS queued, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'running') AS running, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS failed FROM ops.job

SELECT e.created_at, e.recipe, e.verdict, m.model_semver, m.status, e.folds, (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.verdict = 'skip') FROM score.shadow_decision s WHERE s.eval_id = e.eval_id) AS skips FROM score.eval_run e LEFT JOIN train.model_version m USING (model_semver) ORDER BY e.created_at DESC LIMIT 40

panels.title: Shadow skips by asset and reason (latest evaluation per recipe)

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.recipe, s.asset, s.reason_code, count(*) AS days, round(avg(s.y)::numeric, 3) AS mean_r FROM score.shadow_decision s JOIN score.eval_run e USING (eval_id) WHERE e.created_at = (SELECT max(created_at) FROM score.eval_run e2 WHERE e2.recipe = e.recipe) AND s.verdict = 'skip' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2
